output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When minting tokens, the balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount; totalSupply += mintedAmount; is executed, which can overflow mintedAmount causing a buy function vulnerability.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When executing balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value; balanceOf[_to] += _value; it can overflow _value causing a buy function vulnerability.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When executing balanceOf[_from] -= _value; balanceOf[_to] += _value; it can overflow _value causing a buy function vulnerability.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When minting tokens, the balanceOf[this] -= amount; balanceOf[msg.sender] += amount; is executed, which can overflow amount causing a buy function vulnerability.
The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When executing balanceOf[this] += amount; balanceOf[msg.sender] -= amount; it can overflow amount causing a sell function vulnerability.
